en.name: Brioche
en.summary: Brioche keeps 2–4 days wrapped at room temperature and 3–6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Both figures are borrowed from commercial cakes and muffins, the nearest published match — no agency publishes a brioche timeline. Refrigeration is not worth it unless you are going to toast it.
en.pantry: 2–4 days wrapped at room temperature. The butter and egg yolk in a brioche coat the starch and slow retrogradation, so it stays soft noticeably longer than a lean loaf — but that same richness makes it a better substrate for mould, and the soft, moist crumb holds humidity. Keep it in a paper bag or a bread bin rather than sealed plastic: a bread study measured markedly higher humidity inside a plastic bag, with mould appearing a day or so sooner than in paper. Treat these numbers as sensible working guidance rather than as a documented limit.
en.fridge: Only if you are going to toast it. Cold stales bread faster than the counter does, enrichment or no enrichment; the fat delays retrogradation but does not reverse its direction. What the fridge does buy is time against mould, which is the failure brioche actually suffers in a hot humid kitchen — and since toasting reverses staling by re-gelatinising the starch, a wrapped brioche in the fridge destined for the toaster or for French toast costs you nothing. For a loaf you want soft and plain, the freezer is the better answer.
en.freezer: 3–6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F), and brioche freezes very well because the fat protects the crumb from ice damage. Freeze individual buns, or slice a loaf first, then wrap tight with the air excluded. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe indefinitely; the window describes quality — dryness, ice crystals and freezer burn — not safety. Thaw at room temperature, or toast slices straight from frozen.
en.thawing: Thaw wrapped at room temperature, or toast from frozen. Brioche that thawed in the fridge and is still cold may be refrozen with some quality loss; brioche thawed on a warm counter should not be refrozen.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould spots — throw out the whole loaf, not just the affected part.
A sour or fermented smell, often from bread bagged while still warm.
A dry, crumbly crumb that no longer pulls into strands.
A rancid or crayon-like taste from the butter, in a loaf kept far too long.
tips: Paper bag or bread bin on the counter; sealed plastic brings mould forward.
Slice before freezing so you can take one slice at a time.
Stale brioche is the best possible French toast — it is not a failure state.
Buy small loaves or buns; enriched bread is at its best in the first couple of days.

faq.a: 2–4 days wrapped at room temperature, or 3–6 months from purchase in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Both figures are read across from commercial cakes and muffins.

faq.q: Should brioche go in the fridge?
faq.a: Only if you will toast it. Chilling stales it faster, but it does hold off mould, and toasting undoes the staling.
Yes, and it freezes better than lean bread because the butter protects the crumb. Slice it first and toast straight from frozen.

zh.name: 布里歐麵包
zh.summary: 布里歐包好放室溫可放 2～4 天，−18 °C 冷凍自購買日起是 3～6 個月。這兩個數字都是比照市售蛋糕與瑪芬而來——資料裡最接近的一類——沒有機關為布里歐公布期限。除非你打算烤過再吃，否則冷藏並不值得。
zh.pantry: 包好放室溫 2～4 天。布里歐裡的奶油和蛋黃會裹住澱粉、拖慢回凝，所以它比瘦麵包軟得久得多；但同樣的豐腴也讓它成為更好的長霉溫床，柔軟潮濕的內裡本身就含著濕氣。請用紙袋或麵包盒，不要密封塑膠袋：一份麵包研究量到塑膠袋內的濕度明顯更高，長霉也比裝紙袋的早了一天左右。這些數字請當成合理的參考，而不是有文件背書的上限。
zh.fridge: 只有在你打算烤過再吃時才冷藏。低溫讓麵包老化得比室溫快，不管它有多豐腴；油脂會拖慢回凝，但改變不了方向。冷藏買到的是對抗霉的時間，而在又熱又濕的廚房裡，霉正是布里歐真正的死因——既然烤過可以讓澱粉重新糊化、把老化逆轉回來，那麼一條注定要進烤箱或做成法式吐司的布里歐放冷藏，其實什麼代價都沒付。想要它保持柔軟原味的話，冷凍才是更好的答案。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 3～6 個月；布里歐非常耐凍，因為油脂會保護內裡不被冰晶破壞。整顆小圓麵包分開冷凍，或整條先切片再包緊、擠掉空氣。只要全程沒退冰就一直是安全的；這個期限描述的是品質——變乾、冰晶和凍燒——不是安全。包著在室溫解凍，或把切片直接從冷凍烤。
zh.thawing: 包好在室溫解凍，或直接從冷凍烤。在冷藏解凍、而且還是冰的布里歐可以再冷凍，只是品質會打折；在溫暖檯面上解凍過的就不要再凍回去。
spoilage: 長出絨毛狀霉點——整條丟掉，不是只切掉那一塊。
聞起來發酸或有發酵味，通常是還熱著就裝袋造成的。
內裡變乾、一撕就碎，拉不出絲。
放太久的那種奶油油耗味、像蠟筆的味道。
tips: 檯面上用紙袋或麵包盒；密封塑膠袋會讓霉提早報到。
冷凍前先切片，之後可以一次只拿一片。
放到有點乾的布里歐是做法式吐司最好的材料，那不是壞掉。
買小條或小顆的；豐腴麵包最好吃的就是最初那兩天。

faq.a: 包好放室溫 2～4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍自購買日起 3～6 個月。兩個數字都是比照市售蛋糕與瑪芬而來。

faq.q: 布里歐要放冰箱冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 只有打算烤過再吃時才需要。低溫會讓它老化更快，但確實壓得住霉，而烤過又能把老化逆轉回來。
可以，而且比瘦麵包更耐凍，因為奶油會保護內裡。先切片，要吃時直接從冷凍烤。
